text: レッド　ありがとう　それにしても…　あんな　ひどい　やつらが　わたしの　うまれた　しまに　はびこって　いた　なんて　しらなかったわ…

structure.jp: レッド　ありがとう
あんな　ひどい　やつらが
わたしの　うまれた　しまに
structure.en: on the island where I was born

structure.jp: はびこって　いた　なんて
structure.en: that they had been running rampant

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.span: はびこって　いた　なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a statement holds it up as something shocking, like 'to think that'. はびこって　いた　なんて = 'that they had been running rampant, of all things'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: わたしの　うまれた　しま
patterns.explanation: The words before しま describe it, and の here plays the part of が. わたしの　うまれた　しま = 'the island where I was born'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on over a stretch of past time. はびこって　いた = 'had been running rampant'.
